title: Network Pharmacology Combined with Machine Learning to Reveal the Action Mechanism of Licochalcone Intervention in Liver Cancer.
authors: Guo, Fangfang; Yang, Xiaotang; Hu, Chengxiang; Li, Wannan; Han, Weiwei
one_liner_zh: 该文用网络药理学和机器学习研究甘草查尔酮类化合物抗肝癌机制，涉及小分子-蛋白互作，但对象为药物-蛋白而非蛋白质-DNA互作，且无TF-DNA结合建模，与本课题关联微弱。
abstract: There are reports indicating that licochalcones can inhibit the proliferation, migration, and invasion of cancer cells by promoting the expression of autophagy-related proteins, inhibiting the expression of cell cycle proteins and angiogenic factors, and regulating autophagy and apoptosis. This study aims to reveal the potential mechanisms of licochalcone A (LCA), licochalcone B (LCB), licochalcone C (LCC), licochalcone D (LCD), licochalcone E (LCE), licochalcone F (LCF), and licochalcone G (LCG) inhibition in liver cancer through computer-aided screening strategies. By using machine learning clustering analysis to search for other structurally similar components in licorice, quantitative calculations were conducted to collect the structural commonalities of these components related to liver cancer and to identify key residues involved in the interactions between small molecules and key target proteins. Our research results show that the seven licochalcones molecules interfere with the cancer signaling pathway via the NF-kappaB signaling pathway, PDL1 expression and PD1 checkpoint pathway in cancer, and others. Glypallichalcone, Echinatin, and 3,4,3',4'-Tetrahydroxy-2-methoxychalcone in licorice also have similar structures to the seven licochalcones, which may indicate their similar effects. We also identified the key residues (including ASN364, GLY365, TRP366, and TYR485) involved in the interactions between ten flavonoids and the key target protein (nitric oxide synthase 2). In summary, we provide valuable insights into the molecular mechanisms of the anticancer effects of licorice flavonoids, providing new ideas for the design of small molecules for liver cancer drugs.
abstract_zh: 有报道指出，甘草查尔酮可通过促进自噬相关蛋白表达、抑制细胞周期蛋白和血管生成因子表达以及调节自噬和凋亡来抑制癌细胞的增殖、迁移和侵袭。本研究旨在通过计算机辅助筛选策略揭示甘草查尔酮A (LCA)、甘草查尔酮B (LCB)、甘草查尔酮C (LCC)、甘草查尔酮D (LCD)、甘草查尔酮E (LCE)、甘草查尔酮F (LCF) 和甘草查尔酮G (LCG) 抑制肝癌的潜在机制。通过使用机器学习聚类分析搜索甘草中其他结构相似的成分，进行了定量计算以收集这些与肝癌相关的成分的结构共性，并识别小分子与关键靶蛋白相互作用中涉及的关键残基。我们的研究结果表明，这七种甘草查尔酮分子通过NF-kappaB信号通路、癌症中的PDL1表达和PD1检查点通路等干扰癌症信号通路。甘草中的甘草查尔酮、Echinatin和3,4,3',4'-四羟基-2-甲氧基查尔酮也与这七种甘草查尔酮具有相似结构，这可能表明它们具有相似的作用。我们还识别了十种类黄酮与关键靶蛋白（诱导型一氧化氮合酶2）相互作用中涉及的关键残基（包括ASN364、GLY365、TRP366和TYR485）。总之，我们为甘草类黄酮抗癌作用的分子机制提供了有价值的见解，为肝癌药物小分子的设计提供了新思路。
